text:
mina: Planning retest for payment flow (ACME). Target window Fri 2026-04-18 09:00-12:00 PDT. Need owners for RBAC, KMS access, audit export, and rollback.

chen: I can take RBAC + rollback. Proposing ephemeral role 'pt_assessor' TTL 4h, perms: kms:Decrypt on alias/assess/pay, logs:FilterLogEvents for payment lambda, s3:GetObject on evidence bucket. No DB access.

olivia: For KMS, grant via access-proxy assume-role with aws:SourceIp condition locked to assessor VPN. Add principal tag assessment=ACME-2026 on assume so KMS key policy can log tag.

raj: I'll prepare terraform module and small smoke test. Will tag resources with assessment and window.

mina: Evidence: 7-day CloudTrail export + filtered CloudWatch logs + mapping file (sts_session -> principal_arn -> source_ip). Presigned S3 links expire 8h and go into evidence-vault.

chen: Rollback steps (aim <10m): revoke sessions, detach policy, remove presigned links (replace object), rotate key if misuse. I'll add exact aws cli commands to runbook.

olivia: Also enforce log-group resource policy to prevent deletion and bump retention to 30d for payment logs. Add monitor for kms:Decrypt outside window.

security-bot: Reminder: populate assessment tracker: https://tracker.redwood.internal/assessments/ACME-2026-required fields: start_time,end_time,roles, kms_alias,evidence_bucket,contacts. Next reminder in 48h.

mina: Owners/ETA: chen RBAC+rollback (4h), raj terraform+smoke (6h), olivia KMS+logs (5h), mina calendar+tracker (done). Dry-run scheduled tomorrow 11:00.
